name: hover-card
useFor: Use to preview a linked thing in running text (a substation's voltage, owner and distance) without leaving the page. The link still works on click.
constraints: The only place a fact appears
Actions or fields inside the card
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the popover's panel
title: Hover Card
description: The popover's panel (Bone, 6px cut corner, 1px Stone line, no shadow) shown after a 400ms dwell on a link, with a short preview of what it points to.
